flux_compression.note: Point-dipole bubble at the stopping radius; flux-conserving coils without cryostat eddy shielding (an upper bound on the coil response; the microsecond pulse is screened by the cryostat walls, which then carry the eddy heating instead). Not valid (valid = false) when the bubble reaches within 0.8 of the nearest cryostat: then the coils sit inside the compressed field and only a coupled plasma model can give their load.
